_tuning_notes: Black bear: forests, smaller (size_scale), and special.timid makes it FLEE players — unless cubs are nearby, when mother-aggro overrides everything. Same class as the taiga grizzly. Phase 3: salmon (diet) baits cage traps; needs the reinforced tier. RARITY: tier 'uncommon' supplies the spawn weight; group_size and nearby_cap are pinned here (1-3, cap 3). nearby_cap denies natural spawns when that many of this animal are already within 64 blocks — the fix for persistent CREATURE mobs accumulating forever.
guide_blurb: Shy, unless you find the cubs first.
